title: Kanashibari
body:
Syntax: perform kanashibari <target>

Description: A binding illusion that can briefly paralyze the target.  Its paralysis can block actions briefly. Usable with any chakra nature. Base damage: 62-71. 50% chance to inflict paralyzed. The effect lasts 10 seconds before resistance. Unlocks at level 28. Costs 26 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 8 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
